exposure: continuous electronic fetal heart monitoring (EFM) with daily biophysical profile (BPP)
Fetal assessment strategy: non-stress test (NST) three times per day
Fetal assessment strategy: continuous electronic fetal heart monitoring (EFM) with daily biophysical profile (BPP)
cohort: 180 singleton pregnancies with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) at 23(0)-33(6) weeks of gestation that underwent expectant management
finding: Continuous electronic fetal heart monitoring with daily biophysical profile was associated with higher rates of intervention and cesarean delivery compared to periodic non-stress tests, but there was no difference in intrauterine or perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Continuous EFM with daily BPP was associated with higher rates of cesarean delivery compared with periodic NST.
